## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Sun Eater Kayle. 1 file for all chromas.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Sun Eater Kayle

**Affects**: VFX colors

Adds matching VFX colors to every chroma, base remains the same. You need to own the chroma and choose it in champ select in order to use this mod.
